instanceResults.ruleDescription: The CLI command update:workflow has been replaced with publish:workflow and unpublish:workflow for better clarity.

instanceIssues.title: CLI command update:workflow replaced
instanceIssues.description: The CLI command update:workflow has been replaced with publish:workflow and unpublish:workflow. If you were using this command in scripts or automation, you will need to update your approach.

recommendations.action: Use the API to activate workflows
recommendations.description: Update automation scripts to use the public API to activate workflows individually instead of the CLI command
Check any deployment or automation scripts that may have used the CLI command to activate all workflows and update them accordingly

instanceResults.ruleTitle: Require auth on OAuth callback URLs by default
instanceResults.ruleDescription: OAuth callbacks now enforce n8n user authentication by default for improved security

instanceIssues.title: OAuth callback authentication now required
instanceIssues.description: OAuth callbacks will now enforce n8n user authentication by default unless N8N_SKIP_AUTH_ON_OAUTH_CALLBACK is explicitly set to true.

recommendations.description: If you need to skip authentication on OAuth callbacks (e.g., for embed mode), set N8N_SKIP_AUTH_ON_OAUTH_CALLBACK=true

instanceResults.ruleTitle: Remove task runner from n8nio/n8n docker image
instanceResults.ruleDescription: Task runners are no longer included in the n8nio/n8n docker image and must use the separate n8nio/runners image

instanceIssues.title: Task runner removed from main Docker image
instanceIssues.description: The task runner is no longer bundled with the n8nio/n8n Docker image. If you are using task runners in Docker, you must use the separate n8nio/runners image.

recommendations.description: Change the task runner Docker image from n8nio/n8n to n8nio/runners in your docker-compose.yml or Kubernetes configuration
Set up external task runners using the n8nio/runners image and configure n8n to connect to them using N8N_RUNNERS_MODE=external
Consult the updated task runner documentation for migration steps and configuration examples

instanceResults.ruleDescription: The --tunnel CLI option has been removed and will be ignored

instanceIssues.title: --tunnel option removed
instanceIssues.description: The --tunnel CLI option is no longer available. If you were using this feature, calls with the --tunnel flag will ignore the flag and not run the tunnel system.

instanceResults.ruleDescription: The hooks workflow.activeChange and workflow.activeChangeCurrent are deprecated and replaced by workflow.published

instanceIssues.title: Workflow hooks workflow.activeChange and workflow.activeChangeCurrent deprecated
instanceIssues.description: The workflow.activeChange and workflow.activeChangeCurrent hooks are deprecated and will be removed. These hooks are being replaced by a new workflow.published hook that provides more consistent behavior and is triggered when any version of a workflow is published.

recommendations.description: Update your code to use the new workflow.published hook instead of workflow.activeChange. The new hook will be triggered whenever a workflow version is published.
Update your code to use the new workflow.published hook instead of workflow.activeChangeCurrent. This provides more consistent behavior across workflow publishing actions.
Check any custom integrations, plugins, or extensions that may be using the deprecated workflow hooks and update them to use workflow.published.
